fact: The Second National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS II, 2015/16-2019/20) is stated adopted by the Statistics Council; the document gives no adoption date, so the July 2016 publication date is used.
The preface states a mid-term and a final evaluation of NSDS I (2010/11-2014/15) was conducted with PARIS21, AfDB and ECA; no evaluation date is given, so the July 2016 publication date is used.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2021-2026.

The Reporter says the Ministry of Planning and Development and the Ethiopian Statistics Service launched the Ethiopian Statistical Development Program, costing about ETB 35 billion and running until 2026.

The Ministry of Planning and Development unveiled the Ethiopian Statistics Development Program on 1 February 2024, to be executed over three years and including economic, agricultural and population and housing censuses.
